name: phd-transfer-no-prior-program
description: DGS 2026-10-03 (P1-transfer-eligibility-11: “route such courses to DGS review”): a student with NO earlier graduate program who enters a graduate course from another university. The Academic Code’s §4.6 states a transfer allowance only for an unfinished program (6) and a completed one (9/24), none for courses taken outside any program — so even a course the DGS pre-approved in the course rules is held for the DGS: counted provisionally, the §5.2 row “Waiting for the DGS” with the six of the unfinished case as its meter (decision 2026-08-31), and the review request asking the DGS to decide. §4.4.1 still sees the confirmed core area.
